3. Job Ad Agent ad create chesi human approval kosam wait chestundi
4. Konni agents MCP use chesi direct ga tools tho work chestunnayi
5. Lead Agent tho direct ga chat cheyachu
6. Entire system Claude tho custom ga build chesaru

AI agents real world lo ela work chestunnayo chudali ante ee example interesting.
